set.body:
Source: PRD.html section 9 and requirements F-12 through F-15.

Scope:
- Add declared-output contracts for opaque scripts and distinguish process success from missing or invalid output.
- Define the language-neutral structured worker event and atomic result-envelope protocol.
- Bind envelopes to submission, attempt epoch, operation, result schema, status, value, output names, sizes, and digests.
- Implement a versioned registered Scala task runtime with typed input, bounded typed output, operation registry, worker-release identity, and schema-checked durable reattachment.
- Provide managed input/output/scratch/progress context plus an explicitly lower-assurance native filesystem context.
- Keep retry safety independent of typing and default automatic retry to disabled or unknown.

Acceptance:
- Opaque R or Python examples support exit-only, declared-output, and structured-result modes.
- A registered Scala operation runs effectfully on a worker and returns a schema-validated typed value.
- No closure, Future, arbitrary JVM graph, or IO[A] value is serialized.
- Wrong-schema reattachment, malformed envelope, missing output, and stale epoch all fail safely without typed success.
set.title: P4: Add declared outputs, structured results, and typed Scala tasks
